The Prophet ﷺ gently told the boy in his: Intumwa y’Imana ﷺ yabwiye mu rukundo umuhungu wari mu burere bwayo iti: “Muhungu, vuga izina rya Allah, urye n’ukuboko kw’iburyo kandi urye ibiri imbere yawe” (al-Bukhari 5376).

The Prophet ﷺ said: “No prayer is heavie: Intumwa y’Imana ﷺ yavuze iti: “Nta swala iremereye ku bahemu kurusha Fajr na ‘Isha.” Iminsi mirongo ine ni igihe cyatoranyijwe gusa cyo kubaka umuco — nta gaciro kihariye dutanga ku mubare.
